notes.title: Play Revival on Steam Deck! And check out the other improvements!
notes.content:
Greetings!

The Revival: Recolonization team is here with a fresh update packed with important improvements and fixes. Your gameplay sessions are about to get even more comfortable and smooth.

We’ve added full gamepad support! Now, if a gamepad is connected to your PC, the appropriate control scheme will be displayed when launching the game. On Steam Deck, gamepad controls are selected by default for maximum convenience.

Here’s what else is new:
[list]
[*] Diplomacy with factions has been updated. You can now significantly influence another faction's loyalty through flattery, gifts, slander, and insults.
[*] The use of rewards and punishments in clan diplomacy has been improved for greater effectiveness.
[*] The risk of a city being captured by another faction has been reduced when loyalty is low.
[*] Combat AI has been significantly improved.
[*] An arrow next to the loyalty value of clans and factions now shows the expected loyalty trend over the next few turns: green upward or red downward.
[*] When upgrading or building a unit, a comparison tooltip now appears, showing the stats of the new weapon versus the current one, along with the difference in resource cost.
[/list]
Prepare for new conquests in the world of Revival – now with greater stability and comfort!

Thank you for your continued feedback – together, we’re making the game even better.

Sincerely,

The Revival: Recolonization Team

notes.title: Hotseat mode, a new event system, Polish language, and many other changes!
notes.content:
Greetings!

Here is the Revival: Recolonization team! We've prepared a big content update for the game, including releasing the two-player [b]Hotseat mode[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/3df0b3593910943fce82dc4b3d93d4a10a4c4e26.png[/img]

In addition, we've introduced an event system to the game. Events feature unexpected challenges that players must overcome by using one of the unique traits of their faction. By carefully reading the event descriptions, players can strategize and select the trait that aligns best with the situation. Choosing the right trait can lead to valuable bonuses.

When visiting a town or settlement, you can communicate with the assimilated clan.  Notifications about fulfillment and violation of obligations have been added, along with changes to the AI.

We've changed the logic of AI action when attacking foreign regions. The AI returns units from the attack if there is not enough power to win, and it does not attack the city from the sea. The enemy will only attack if there is enough power in the current state, and it is confident of victory. It will no longer allow the player to impose unfavorable exchanges. Fighting the AI has become more interesting and more difficult. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/8765e7142d0e755620cb48bae59c683244d06d19.png[/img]

What else is new: 

[h3][b]Graphics:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New animations of exploding vehicles with towers flying off have been added.
[*] New edict capsule model with new animations and soundtrack.
[*] Flamethrowers now change colors if you change the tank in the ammo cell.
[/list]
[h3][b]Localization:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Polish language added.
[*] Multiple corrections in the texts.
[*] The Stalkers have been renamed the Diggers.
[/list]
[h3][b]Balance:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The global project “Temple of the All-Mother” gives +2 to the population of new cities instead of +1.
[*] Increased the cost of selecting hexes for the Earthquake edict by 2 times, from 75 to 150.
[*] Increased the cost of running Gravity Edicts at the first level from 25 to 50.
[*] The item “Berserker Charm” gives +3 instead of +1 health points on a kill.
[*] The Berserker Rage science bonus gives +3 health points instead of +1 on a kill.
[*] The Rain Edict now destroys roads outside of cities.
[/list]
[h3][b]Interface:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Additional food creation progress has been added to the city panel. It will appear if a new person is expected to arrive in the city on the next turn and there is an excess of food available.
[*] Added buttons to switch between airfields and missile silos.
[*] Added new animations to interface elements.
[*] Added an option to turn the hex grid on and off in the battle panel.
[*] Options to select the number of factions under AI control in the New Game settings.
[*] Added a new tooltip window for rare resources, where you can see what items require the resource.
[*] The faction color selection has been moved under the emissary portrait.
[*] Changed the tooltip window for equipment items. 
[*] Added a declaration of war option to the diplomacy window on the treaties tab instead of the unavailable truce option.
[*] Added new images for the victory and defeat screens.
[*] Added an item-type icon for the scout.
[*] The task window will now be closed when the game loads after turn 10.
[*] The portraits of emissaries and chiefs in the diplomacy window have been moved to the right.
[*] Commitments now show the time remaining.
[*] The commitment tooltip now has a link to the faction and clan.
[*] The trade window near items now displays the value in reputation if a trade deal is made.
[*] Added a “Find Emissary” button.
[/list]
[h3][b]Sound:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Sounds of units taking damage outside of combat now only play if the player can see them.
[*] Fixed missing explosion sounds for grenades.
[/list]
[h3][b]Settings:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added option to reset settings by category or all at once.
[*] Added a hotkey to reset all settings to default (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F10).
[/list]
[h3][b]Fixed bugs:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The hint window did not always appear correctly.
[*] An exploit that allowed you to lead the same clan twice at the beginning of the game, getting twice the number of troops.
[*] A bug that caused the Great Fountain global project to allow a clan with less loyalty to be assimilated even if it was not a faction vassal and had a different nationality.
[*] Incorrect positioning of chieftain avatars in cities and settlement icons on the strategic map during training.
[*] A bug that could cause victory conditions to not work correctly when loading saves.
[*] Notification sounds are now shorter and less significant.
[*] Missing city walls at the start of battle in some cases.
[*] Displayed city walls in the fog of war in some cases.
[*] The altar’s position will now not be revealed when loading a save.
[*] Squads are now not allowed to move through the altar.
[*] The altar is now not visible in the fog of war.
[*] Renamed the map type selection options in the new game settings window for better understanding.
[*] Incorrect loyalty calculation between factions in case one of them has no cities.
[*] Incorrect notifications when units violate the border.
[*] Houses on empty city hexes will now appear without animation when loading the game.
[*] Missing camera focuses on the location of a clan attack on a town. 
[*] Bug that caused the clan leadership window to display a group tooltip window instead of the warrior description window when hovering over a warrior icon.
[*] The Arch of Valor global project now works correctly when a player attacks a city.
[*] The force shield now does not rotate with the squad.
[*] Quarters are now correctly displayed and hidden in the fog of war.
[*] Faction property bonuses do not show the opening of sciences if they are already open.
[*] Added a shield attack for the Electric Shield item.
[*] Incorrect display of nuclear mine and airfield icons in science hints.
[*] Incorrect display of the interface when it is zoomed in, now it cannot be zoomed in. 
[*] Freezing when AI units move through the clan settlement.
[*] Possible errors when combining units. 
[*] Possible errors during the peaceful capture of a city.
[*] Errors in the AI of missile silos and submarines.
[*] A situation in which it was possible to lead someone else's clan.
[*] A bug where two units could be on the same hex.
[*] Other bugs that caused the game to freeze.
[*] Incorrect display of the prediction scale in the battle dialog. 
[*] Information in the squad hint window when hovering the mouse over a zombie.
[*] Trade deals now display the correct duration in turns (25 turns) when trading with a clan. 
[*] Error in predicting damage received when hovering the mouse over an enemy.
[*] Now, resources received by trade are always displayed on the right, and resources traded away are always displayed on the left.
[*] The bottom right panel now shows a valid emissary portrait. 
[/list]
We hope you enjoy the game and this update! Share your impressions with us here or on [url=https://discord.gg/2WfSpKYwd7]Discord[/url]. 

Regards,
Revival: Recolonization Team

notes.title: Join Beta of Multiplayer Hotseat Mode!
notes.content:
Greetings! 

Our team is busy preparing the next big content update and working to squash all of the bugs we have found. Today, we want to share some big news with you…

We have implemented hotseat functionality in multiplayer. Now, you can play with your friends (or enemies) on the same computer. This new feature and other changes will be available in the game's beta branch.

In addition, we've introduced an event system to the game. Events feature unexpected challenges that players must overcome by using one of the unique traits of their faction. By carefully reading the event descriptions, players can strategize and select the trait that aligns best with the situation. Choosing the right trait can lead to valuable bonuses.

When visiting a town or settlement, you can communicate with the assimilated clan.  Notifications about fulfillment and violation of obligations have been added, along with changes to the AI, and the addition of Polish as a language option.

notes.title: Read about our plans and get Steam community items!
notes.content:
Greetings! 

Thank you to everyone who supported us through the development cycle and 1.0 release of Revival: Recolonization. Creating video games is always a difficult undertaking, but your encouragement kept us motivated.

Now that the game is out of Early Access, we want to tell you about our next big content update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/af1414d675a10162ff6571f3816e484a4c3fde7a.png[/img]

[h3][b]A new random event system[/b][/h3]
We've been working on the new event system for a long time and we think that it's finally ready for release. Events will have much more influence on the gameplay and will be tied to a trie's traits, instead of feeling as though they take place in isolation. You'll have to use your wits and judgment to make the right decision.

[h3][b]QoL changes [/b][/h3]
Thanks to all of the feedback we have received, we were able to compile a large list of improvements for the game. Once they are implemented, players will have the optimal 4x post-apocalyptic experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/80792ea1217b61e873f019ada08bc1b33650d2b2.png[/img]

[h3][b]Community Items [/b][/h3]
We've also added community items! You'll be able to get for your profile:
[list]
[*] 13 Trading Cards,
[*] 6 Profile Backgrounds,
[*] 6 Badges, 
[*] 5 Emoticons. 
[/list]
One small thing about the next update: you will feel very comfortable playing the next update as your seat will get a lot warmer.

Don't forget to join the official [url=https://discord.gg/UtAhBWBXTc]Discord[/url] and be sure to leave your feedback and comments about the game. 

Regards,
Revival: Recolonization Team

notes.title: Increased income for clan loot and fixed bugs
notes.content:
Greetings! 

We have prepared another patch with bug fixes and minor changes. 

New:
[olist]
[*] Now, when a faction dialog appears, the main interface buttons are locked, and it is mandatory to select the acquaintance option.
[*] Violated obligations affect clan loyalty only for 50 turns; previously, they reduced it indefinitely and it could not be fixed.
[*] The amount of income received for clan loot now depends on the era and has been significantly increased. It was 50 gold for the first era, now it’s 500 gold; 1000 for the second; 2000 for the third; and 3000 for the fourth. 
[*] The loyalty factor for capturing a clan now lasts 50 turns instead of 100.
[*] If a Right of Free Pass contract is in place, you can pass your units through units of another faction with which you have this contract.
[*] When attacking without a declaration of war, reputation will be deducted by -5 each turn, instead of -10 as before. 
[*] Reconfiguration of resources used in weapons. Phosphorus can be used more actively.
[*] During trade, you can only exchange sciences with the faction which you have a science contract with. 
[*] Improved combat AI.
[/olist]
Fixed:
[olist]
[*] Fixed the blocker that occurs when trying to build a city on a hex with an altar.
[*] It is now impossible to place a capsule on a hex with an altar.
[*] An error in which a window appeared after clicking on an altar when selecting hexes for a capsule.
[*] Pressing Enter, while the notification box is open, wound end the turn. 
[*] Inability to upgrade a district after making changes to the construction queue.
[*] Now All-Mind will not give new conditions after a victory. 
[*] Construction progress is no longer displayed on the next district if it fails to build due to the lack of population.
[*] Bug that caused the relationship between the selected entity and the hovered-over entity to not be shown sometimes.
[*] It is now impossible to use tooltip actions while a faction dialog is displayed.
[*] Also fixed a number of other minor bugs.
[/olist]
We are working on another big update that will include changes based on your feedback. Thank you for playing Revival, leaving feedback, and sharing your playthrough experience.

Regards,
Revival: Recolonization Team

notes.title: Hotfix! Fixed game freezing bugs and some more
notes.content:
Greetings!

There were a few bugs found in the latest version of the game. Thank you for reporting them. We've already made a few fixes.

Fixed:
[olist]
[*] A bug that caused the tooltip describing the unit type to not disappear after moving the mouse cursor away from the unit portrait.
[*] Bug that caused the forced clan assimilation oath to not be fulfilled if a city was attacked with a clan.
[*] Freezing during game loading.
[*] After deleting a district from the construction queue, the required number of moves to build the next district was not displayed.
[*] Game freezing during an AI move when terminating the Right of Free Pass contract.
[*] Game freezing during the battle completion.
[*] Some interface bugs.
[*] A few visual bugs in the Japanese localization.
[/olist]
Also made easier-to-understand tooltips in the Science Tree. Now, when hovering over an item, there is a tooltip with the era in which it opens rather than the era in which the necessary resource for its creation opens. We made a change in the description of edicts. Now, if the radius of an edict is 0, the description displays 0, not the word “hex” as before.

We hope you are enjoying playing Revival: Recolonization. Share your impressions in the discussions and don't forget to write reviews.

Regards,

notes.content:

We have big news to share: we're planning a major update for Revival: Recolonization, along with the full release of the game. So, what will be in the big update?

[h2]Two new emissaries[/h2]
We are adding two new playable emissaries, each with completely new mechanics. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/zrXrD3d/image.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/2c77ce4cd4c08d231f4ae01f4bf1544fd4415385.png[/img]

Lotus is an environmentally friendly emissary that can change the climate of a hex simply by walking through it. With it, climate expansion will be much easier, and you will always fight on your territory. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/ff9dd66d75a1d55179eb9cdb96547a8157080918.png[/img]

Val’fest is a master of diplomacy. By spending his reputation, he can convince rival armies to join his side.

Fight for dominance in the surroundings of the Earth, the cradle of human civilization. We're adding the "Earth" option to our map types.

notes.title: Updated the event and victory systems and added submarines!
notes.content:
Greetings!

We have prepared the next big content update for Revival: Recolonization. The update contains a wide array of tweaks and changes to give you the best 4x gaming experience.

[h2]New random events[/h2]

We've thoroughly redesigned the in-game random event system to give you a more varied experience when playing a long game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/3f6498eb1d0a48f4a2570e473fbd9313e95ce3ea.png[/img]

Previously, event choices were inconsequential, but in the latest update, each event presents a unique problem to solve. The correct choice will reward you with a buff. These can be accomplished with the help of one of your clans.

We hope that this system will encourage you to further understand the clan properties!. 

[h2]New victory options[/h2]

The victory system has also received a complete overhaul. To assess the reasonableness of humans, the All-Mind organizes competitions between factions with various time-limited tasks. The faction that completes the task better than the rest will receive the Sign of Rationality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/828bc3255aa3ed70cab177f172e0e17599256177.png[/img]

Once a faction has three Signs of Rationality, the All-Mind will recognize that faction's supremacy over the AI, unlock the interplanetary portal, and then self-destruct itself.

You can still win with military might – if any competing faction is destroyed, you will receive all of the Signs of Rationality previously earned by that faction.

Also, we've added a scientific-based way to win, allowing you to cheat the All-Mind and unlock the portal by learning a special science.

[h2]New combat units[/h2]

You can now use nuclear submarines and aircraft carriers in Revival: Recolonization. Submarines allow you to strike the enemy with a nuclear missile, while aircraft carriers will launch airplanes.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_63d132aef8694fd3b211d94c3983f289~mv2.gif[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_b6ae722dc53f4df481418a6314401186~mv2.gif[/img]

They're the equivalent of airbases and missile silos. While building mobile units is restricted to your region, they offer a unique way to disrupt any coastal location on the map.

[h2]Diplomatic changes[/h2]

Finally, the Military Treaty has been added to the game. If two factions have signed a military treaty, they can use each other's units during a battle against a common enemy. Units of the allied faction will appear as reinforcements before the battle begins. However, you must pay your ally with reputation points to add them to battle.  

To take advantage of this feature, several conditions must be met:
[list]
[*] Your faction and the ally faction must be at war with a third faction. 
[*] Your army and the ally's army must be on the same continent. 
[/list]
This feature does not work against clans and automatons; you will still have to fight them with your own forces. 

We hope you enjoy this update! Share your impressions here or in Steam discussions, and join the community on [url=https://discord.gg/a3cnE2fs3C]Discord[/url]. 

The current version is called 1.0 because we've delivered all the content we promised in the roadmap. However, the game will stay in Early Access for a while because we want to polish, iterate, and build upon this version. We will keep you informed about the release date early next year.

Regards,
Revival: Recolonization Team

notes.title: New Revival: Recolonization update!
notes.content:
Greetings! 

Based on all of our players' feedback and wishes, we have prepared a brand new and robust update for Revival: Recolonization. We're going to tell you about all of these amazing changes.

We updated and refined the mini-tutorial so that it is better at guiding players along the optimal development path while providing up-to-date hints about the game.

And we have finalized the starting tutorial so that it teaches new players more about the gameplay and features. There is also a change of style for the dialogue and plot – Tania will find herself on another planet during the tutorial and then move to Earth.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_6eeed152626b464b934aa12d2c91a55e~mv2.gif[/img]

The important changes that will affect the overall dynamics of the game:
[list]
[*] Added the ability to skip animation during AI movement. This will reduce the waiting time during the enemy's turn.
[*] Optimized the AI algorithms to further reduce the waiting time during its turn.
[*] To speed up progress in the initial phase of the game, we tied the opening of several sciences to the clans' traits. Also, we fixed some logical errors, for example, for a clan with the trait “Merchants,” the science "Trade" was unexplored. Now, each of the three traits of the clan opens one of the sciences. After assimilation, the player gets a new trait and, at the same time, immediately opens the corresponding science, if it was not opened earlier. This allows you to develop faster, get more effective weapons, and move on to the next era. 
[*] Reduced the amount of damage when escaping from the battlefield. Previously, it was 50% and led to a slow down of map exploration during the early stages of the game. Now, the amount of damage will depend on the epoch: 20% damage on the first epoch, 30% damage on the second epoch, and 50% damage on the last two epochs.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/f5b250ae589b4c357aeb1335add6cf900f1a1518.png[/img]
Radically changed the system of edicts. They no longer need to be studied as sciences, but rather unlocked with the “Control Module.” The player obtains the Control Module when visiting any previously unexplored ruin. With the same control module, previously unlocked edicts can be strengthened.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_38ab0aaf95154d4780131024fb8bbfb8~mv2.gif [/img]
Interface:
[list]
[*] Added a button that allows you to rename a city.
[*] Added a notification to change the climate of a player's city if the hexes under the city blocks have a climate different from the clan's native climate.
[*] Changed the menu for creating new units. Previously, from the list of possible units, it was impossible to understand the difference between them at all. Replaced the text name of a unit with icons showing their armor. 
[*] Changed the “Empire Plans” window. It no longer needs to be explored. Empire plans options are available, depending on the player's current era. 
[*] Changed the diplomacy window with the clan, in particular the “Actions” tab. The oaths to the clan are placed on separate bars with buttons that say how much loyalty will add to this or that action. In previous versions of the game, oaths were in a drop-down list and were very invisible, but this is the main tool to influence loyalty. They also changed the size of some buttons and their location. “Assimilate” and “Vassalize” buttons are larger than the others, because these are the most important actions with the clan.
[/list]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_55bc3eda543b4b4793b9c519e76fb4ef~mv2.gif[/img]

Changed the principle of using the “Unit Editor.” It is no longer necessary to create unit types (templates), and the unit editor is used to upgrade a unit. The editor button has been removed from the top panel. 

At any time, you can click on the unit settings icon (gear) and see which parts it consists of. You can also change the weapon and apply this change if the treasury has enough resources for it, and if the unit is in your region. 

You can also use the unit editor in the city to customize the desired weapon, and then click the “Build” button, and the unit will begin construction.

Unfortunately, the old mobile phone version of Reviva will be removed from the game due to a conflict with antivirus programs. 

Korean and Japanese languages have also been added. 

Thank you for supporting our project and team. We are trying to make the game better and are already working on further improvements according to the roadmap. Share your impressions of the game in the comments and join our [url=https://discord.gg/92jBgJsvsD]Discord[/url]. 

Regards,
Revival: Recolonization Team

notes.title: The First Revival: Recolonization Patch
notes.content:
Greetings! 

We want to thank all the players who have joined the Revival: Recolonization community. Your game impressions and feedback help us to find the game’s weak spots, improve gameplay and mechanics, and fix bugs. 

Here’s a patch that fixes several issues and enhances gameplay. 

[b]What's new: 
[/b]
1. The AI turn waiting time has been reduced by 40% in the early and mid-game phases. We plan to continue improving this aspect. 

2. You can now build as many Nexuses as you want. As Emperor Palpatine said, "UNLIMITED POWER!!!" 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/122e69828db9c56309653f1a18bb44e81ab3728d.png[/img]

3. Before the battle starts, the support squad's status is displayed in the accompanying window. If a squad has already participated in a battle in that turn, it will be displayed as inactive. So you can assess your available resources before the battle begins. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/b1306a32f7d44a79963d00c6630e6a9a64325913.png[/img]

4. We made the interaction with the Worker unit more understandable. The game interface did not clearly show the difference between inactive and active buildings that the unit can build when studying related science and having strategic resources on the hex with the Worker. Now, if the unit is on a hex where it cannot build a certain object, the corresponding buttons appear inactive. When you hover over them, a tooltip appears with an explanation. 

5. Now, after the Emissaries' recovery, their health is fully restored. The statuses received before death in battle are removed.

6. City districts are now built at the same level as the town hall (the city's central building). If your town hall is from the third era, all new city districts will be built at the third era level. 

7. Shields do not prevent the owner of the region from using edicts anymore. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/84be5b8313684c8fbf65622786a7a9673d12bffd.png[/img]

[b]The patch also makes some changes to the combat system. Specifically: 
[/b]
1. Archers can now retreat from enemies, without triggering the control zone. 
2. We increased the priority of the "Shield Bash" AI attack if it pushes a unit into the sea. However, "Shield Bash" no longer affects artillery and mobile troops (too heavy). 
3. We fixed a bug where ranged units received the "Electrified" status after being attacked by a unit with the "GMO: Shock Feedback". 
4. We made changes to the battle interface. Now, units that have already taken their turn in combat appear less noticeably on the menu panel than units that the player has not yet used. 
5. We fixed a bug where a unit with the "Frozen" status could attack and move under the influence of the "Mind Control" edict. 
6. Hotkeys are now available in combat. You can see them on the game’s settings screen. 
7. The turn automatically passes from the Emissary to another unit in battle only if the Emissary launches an edict. 
8. We limited the camera's distancing in a battle for a more optimal gaming experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/d42dc6b57c91a6f5416d790424e156e15d3218f7.png[/img]

[b]Based on your feedback, we made changes to the game interface: [/b]

1. We increased the tooltip display speed. For example, popup windows with hex climate type. 
2. Now, when you hover over a unit on the global map, the unit's description group window is always displayed. 
3. We updated the composition of the anomaly descriptions in their tooltip (a popup window that appears when hovering over it). Now, you can see immediately what effects the anomaly has on nearby hexes or regions. 
4. We updated the composition of edict descriptions - the impact on enemy squads in battle is now listed first. 
5. We fixed different icon sizes in science tooltips. 
6. We fixed the lack of changes when scaling the interface if applied in the main menu after a match. 

[b]
We also fixed other minor bugs and issues, including: [/b]

1. Inaccessibility of the city after building the Cathedral of Reconciliation. 
2. Inability to join a city from the Free Towns faction while having sufficient resources. 
3. Incorrect counting of the number of grown forests and bushes. Now, fires and high-to-low growth conversion do not affect it. 
4. The absence of a number on the resource exchange screen for "Edicts" and "Science" resources. 
5. The absence of a lock on the contract duration (increasing or decreasing) button when reaching the limit. 
6. The possibility to change the term in the contract offered by AI.
7. An issue when the construction queue in the city panel was not updated after destroying a district. 
8. Opening the edict screen by hotkey “C”, even if the unit has no moves left. 
9. The empire plans launching screen not closing after some other screens appears. 
10. We removed extraneous sounds in the tutorial intro video. 
11. We fixed incorrect music playback in the tutorial. 

Thanks a lot for supporting us in our 4X strategy game development path. 
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/pJ2YedmgcE]Discord[/url] and share your feedback on the game. 

Best regards, 
The Revival: Recolonization team.

notes.title: Revival - Early Access Roadmap
notes.content:
Greetings!

Today, we want to tell you all about the Revival: Recolonization roadmap. This is our chance to show off some of the future updates and changes coming to the game.

The roadmap covers three major updates and a slew of minor ones, but the list is not set in stone. Releasing the game into Early Access (EA) will allow our team to collect player feedback and react to it, so the contents of the roadmap may change. 

We look forward to hearing your opinions and ideas on how to shape Revival into the best game it can be. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/907445f919b9b14b1f3689bd04be1400cc20d15e.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Early Access Features[/b][/h2]

The EA version of Revival: Recolonization is a fully playable game. It presents the base game experience, but it's missing a few features outlined in the roadmap below. Here is what's available out of the gate:

[list]
[*] The edict system – offering you the freedom to influence the game world and its ruleset. Adapting to new conditions and taking control of your surroundings is key to not only surviving, but thriving in the world of Revival.
[*] Unit Editor – build and command an army that is suited to your play style by gearing up troops with a variety of components, which can also be crafted.
[*] A standard game mode with a Domination type victory condition. You also get to customize map size, game speed, difficulty, terrain layout, and more. 
[*] Two starter emissaries to choose from – Tano and Tania Olazzar, a brother and sister struggling to navigate a post-apocalyptic version of Earth while overcoming their differences.
[*] Five different peoples – each one having to adapt in different ways to their life on the transformed planet. They will differ in culture and attributes. You will need to keep these differences in mind if you want to expand your civilization beyond the starting region.
[*] Four distinct eras to progress through – pick the right clan to take under your wing and help your followers evolve all the way to futuristic settlements and breakthrough technology.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/c900b795075d78f8150a234414353b3fc5f16954.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Quality of Life (QoL) Update[/b][/h2]
Any critical bugs found after the EA launch will be fixed – and we will incorporate further improvements to the game – in one or two QoL updates.

Once our team is happy with the core gameplay, and we are sure we have a strong foundation to build on, we will be expanding the scope and depth of Revival: Recolonization with new features and systems.

Here are just some of the cool things that you’ll get to experience first-hand during EA.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/9d934608d871a6732b95d559f2be64741cfba0af.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Event System Update[/b][/h2]
Create your own unique narrative with faction traits that you'll acquire during a game session.

Each clan in Revival: Recolonization has three clan traits that determine its social composition and cultural values. When you pick a clan to lead, your faction inherits all three of its traits, as well as a unique trait from the people that your chosen clan belongs to.

We will be expanding the in-game event system to factor in traits when generating new events, missions, as well as their outcomes. Any trait associated with your faction can initiate such an event. 

As you make decisions during events, your faction may gain or lose one or more of its traits. For example, a group of bounty hunters may approach you and demand that you release a band of travelers under the "Murderers" trait that you’ve sheltered in the previous event. You can choose to fight them or you can give up the band, losing the "Murderers" trait in the process. 

Your choice of which clans to lead and assimilate will influence how the game session plays out. Will you lead a bunch of desperate savages and cutthroats, or a peace-loving group of scientists and farmers? It is up to you to decide!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_a3a3ae62c4bd4ea78ad225fad6dacb27~mv2.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Victory Conditions Update[/b][/h2]
In our opinion, victory conditions in most 4x games are a bit too static and lead to flat, predictable late game outcomes. Our team aims to solve this issue by implementing victory conditions that:

[list]
[*] stimulate conflict and interaction between factions, 
[*] show the player clear progress towards their end goal and 
[*] reward the player for their efforts.
[/list] 
We see victory conditions as scenarios closely tied to player actions, the various goals they may wish to pursue, and their views on the best future for humankind. For example, you may wish to embrace transhumanism and acquire a rare resource to repair the All-Mind’s (rogue AI) neural network. The repair process takes time, giving opposing factions an opportunity to intervene. 

On the other hand, you can also attempt to completely destroy the All-Mind by acquiring three parts of a certain cipher. This will launch a virus from a secret base on the game map, eradicating the AI. 

Whatever the role you would like to play in a particular game session – a successful diplomat, an insidious conqueror, a mad scientist, etc. – victory conditions should ideally provide a fun means of achieving your goals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/55aef7d89a5fc8c1e108bed349e013f9755b9ee6.png[/img]

[h2][b]Emissary Update[/b][/h2]
Right now, the game is designed and balanced around a single emissary – Tano Olazzar. It made sense to start off with a ‘standard’ style emissary because we need to fine-tune Revival: Recolonization’s various game systems first before we introduce new emissaries.

Faction differentiation is an important part of the design of Revival: Recolonization. Once the first two major updates are in place, we will begin making the two existing emissaries more distinct, and potentially adding new ones. Our goal is to make emissaries (and by association, their factions) different enough, so that playing a particular emissary would allow you to look at the existing game systems from a new perspective.

That's it for the current roadmap. There are still a few big features on the table, such as multiplayer and a map editor, but we will discuss those in the future, as more feedback is received.

Don't forget to share your opinions in the game’s Community Hub and join [url=https://discord.gg/92jBgJsvsD]our Discord.[/url] Thank you for joining us on this grand adventure!

Regards,
Revival: Recolonization Team

notes.title: Enemy AI improved, new effects added, more changes to come!
notes.content:
Greetings!

In today's post, we'll cover some of the upcoming changes and features for the game that we worked on over the past month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/75b37216c9ba4d94f018482d165e89873ec22d62.jpg[/img]

There were further tweaks made to the AI to make sure that interactions with it are more interesting and dynamic. For example, in combat, the enemy can now target a single unit in order to bring it down more effectively. The AI will also make trade deals with clans to obtain the necessary materials needed to expand their empire or build new troop types. 

Some of the development time was devoted to working on animations and adjusting the visual effects in Revival: Recolonization.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_06a94c14be714307af76adb4139cff72~mv2.gif [/img]

In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1306770/view/3377156325974715737]the last update[/url], we told you about the new drop pods that automatons will be using. And now we're ready to show off their landing animation. From the landing hex, the automatons will start moving towards the target region in order to punish any wrongdoers.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_6656df8465574270a51b92a3457c24c3~mv2.gif[/img] 

Animations were introduced for certain weapons that can fire single shots or in bursts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/f1bf21a0f8920111092f66c8fdf4fe20ac079a98.png[/img]

We also completed the monumental task of detailing the weapons in the hands of combat units. The differences between 3D models belonging to the same weapon class are now more noticeable.

Our team is also working on: 
[list]

notes.title: Will you welcome our new robotic overlords?
notes.content:
Greetings! 

The continued development of Revival: Recolonization is going according to plan. And, today, we'd like to remind you about the additional automaton types that our team has been working on. We’ve previously showcased their concept art, now it is time to show the 3D models in the game build.

Please welcome the Scorcher, the Overclocker, and the Bombardier automatons – or don't, as they might just turn out to be your mortal enemies.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_c00065f7252c4b8eabc0a1635a7f937d~mv2.gif[/img]

The Scorcher is equipped with a laser and shield, while the Bombardier is fitted with a large laser in place of its head – creepy, right? But don't count out the Overclocker; it'll strike targets within three hexes with an EMP attack when destroyed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/368a7b03f4ae716e95ac50040644095a11003f29.jpg[/img]

The automatons used to lumber across the map, traversing mountains and valleys to reach their target, which let players quickly catch up to them. This was too easy. Now, the All-Mind's servants will also use drop pods for their transportation needs. Watch out, because they'll land right near your region’s borders.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_e3344e2ec17e41a8ab42a979dbf1ded4~mv2.gif[/img]

The Shard of Singularity is the result of a singularity experiment – it's the pulsating fragment of another world. It serves a single purpose: to transport your forces from one part of the map to another. It's bound to give you a tactical advantage against the All-Mind and other factions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/4b9f3134c9090479d7445f4453366ea05d9930cb.png[/img]

There are also brand new factors for factions. A highly aggressive faction will be labeled as "We are militant people," and won't hesitate when attacking you. The more tolerant peoples will be marked as "We are peaceful people."

In addition to this, we've also: 
[list]
[*] Added new sciences: Community Medicine, Singular Technology, Expropriation, and Ancestral Favor. 
[*] Replaced the Energy Shield model. 
[*] Added a personal radar as equipment for infantry and an integrated radar for artillery and mobile troops.
[*] Began work on updating the UI visuals. 
[/list]
The Early Access release is just around the corner. Be sure to add the game to your Steam Wishlist and join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/92jBgJsvsD]Discord[/url]. See you soon!

Regards, 
Revival: Recolonization Team

notes.title: New Models, Lots of Small Things, and Plans
notes.content:
Greetings! 

After a little break, we're back! Did you miss us? We hope so because we've got a lot of updates for you.

First, we have improved the military AI. The AI will now prioritize studying the edicts and quickly adapt to your fighting style while selecting the best equipment to deal with your forces. Your fight for the world of Revival: Recolonization is not going to be an easy one.

In addition to this, we have also fixed a large number of bugs that occured during combat and improved various animations and effects. Now, shells will no longer explode inside of guns. The sciences of different Peoples have been redistributed per epoch. And we took some time to introduce basic animation chains for vehicles in combat. 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_596df632bcb14e3b9e39e9307b10b989~mv2.gif[/img]

The movement of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1306770/view/5144786299682641086]ships[/url] has also been changed. Now, the range of navigation depends on the level of the port, and the number of units depends on the capability of the port. The higher the port, the more watercraft you'll have at your disposal.

We are also working on adding the missing icons for infantry and mobile artillery weapons. 

Some of the new features and improvements we've added to the game:
[list]
[*] The previously-used term "Tribe" is now "People";
[*] Shaman models for different Peoples;
[*] Influence of loyalty on city resources;
[*] Ability to extinguish fires with Worker units.
[*] Ability to repair armor with a Worker. All friendly units with damaged armor in adjacent hexes to the Worker will now gain the Armor Repair status and have +1 Armor restored at the start of their turn.
[*] Outposts will be created after defeating a settlement;
[*] Ability to destroy any anomaly with the Earthquake edict;
[*] Ability to construct a path to the dark area of the map; 
[*] Elephants can now crush infantry and zombies with an ability.
[/list]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_bd5a4aee30b44b0abcd80fb5ea39c6e7~mv2.gif[/img]

Our artists and modelers and continuing to work on and improve assets in Revival: Recolonization. For example, there are already models for unique Peoples' districts in the game.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_67efde53b9d6479ea5709df38cfb10dd~mv2.gif[/img]

The Sacrificial Obelisk, a unique district, has been added with its own progression through the four epochs. Once this has been built, you will have the opportunity to sacrifice one of the residents in your city to obtain a large Prosperity bonus. And it looks quite creepy!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_fb54af4f562342a18cb9f9d12f2f50a9~mv2.gif[/img]

We've added another unique district, The Vault of Truth, also with its own progression through the epochs. Building it will increase Reputation, and a human sacrifice will grant you a large bonus in Science.

This update isn't just about what we've added to the game, but also what we will include in Revival: Revolonization. These are some of the upcoming work plans for the game: 
[list]
[*] Refinement of shaders for new ruins' models;
[*] Effects of natural anomalies – guaranteed to see soaring rocks and other wonders;
[*] A model of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1306770/view/3077641582857603316]Foundry[/url] for all epochs;
[*] Models of remaining [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1306770/view/3037107931332183780]unique districts[/url];
[*] Adding the Cryo-capsule model. Cryo-capsules were created to keep the emissaries safe from the All-Mind cataclysm raging in the galaxy. They are hidden in the Earth's crust to keep the emissaries as safe as possible.
[*] Finalization of game interfaces;
[*] Adding new animations for infantry.
[/list]
Add Revival: Recolonization to your Wishlist and subscribe to our [url=https://discord.gg/7BSMpdBaea]Discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/HeroCraftPC]Twitter[/url] feeds.

Regards, 
Revival: Recolonization Team

notes.title: Adding more depth and fun to edicts!
notes.content:
Greetings, associate!

The latest Revival playtest is over, and our team is busy processing data and feedback from players. While that is being done, we want to share the changes that have taken place in the edicts system, as well as the latest visual effects work.  

Long-time players know that the [b]Temperature Decrease[/b] edict, as the name implies, lowers the temperature in affected hexes. A desert climate turns into a tropical one, a tropical climate morphs into a temperate climate… you get the picture. Here's what the updated visuals of this edict look like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/85881732a765379fb7a197c07c4c88c2945e39b5.gif[/img]

If [b]Temperature Decrease[/b] is now applied to a hex with a unit standing on it, they will be surrounded by blocks of ice coming out of the ground.  

That’s right! Each strategic edict available on the global map can now also be used in battle. The effects of these micro edicts only last during combat. Unlike global edicts, a micro edict works immediately, and one cannot interfere with it by destroying the capsule the edict was launched from. But you have the ability to launch a counter-edict, which can cancel or alter the effect of the enemy's. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/c24650fd057ba253131ea9f26f8d310d9d44ffd9.png[/img]

The image above shows the effects of some edicts on the game map. Here are just a few of them:

[list]
[*] If you launch the [b]Acid Rain[/b] edict in a Cold climate, an acidic glacier will form in its place. 

[*] The [b]Spore Germination[/b] edict creates a shrub on the target hex and the six closest hexes. It will spawn vines and roots that entangle an enemy unit, preventing them from moving for two turns. 

[*] A [b]Contamination[/b] edict will appear as a crack in the ground with a radioactive glow. Until the rift is closed, zombies will emerge from it, attacking all factions indiscriminately, except for other zombies and automatons. 
[/list]
Speaking of cracks, below are the updated visuals for the Earthquake edict.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/f7f8da647f77f9d3d92055e1db5df24e9338d9cb.gif[/img]

More cool changes are coming in the near future! We hope to release an updated game build in about 4 weeks time. Look forward to your comments and feedback ;) 

Yours faithfully, 
Revival: Recolonization Team

notes.content:

We are happy to announce that the latest version of Revival has just become available. You can access it via the "Download Demo" button on the game's store page.*

Join humanity's fight against the All-Mind!

Here is a list of changes and improvements to the game:

[b]Combat[/b]:
Added animations, explosion, glow and smoke effects for a number of vehicles.
Added the rocket launcher model.
Fixed errors that occurred when players made several consecutive shots from a number of vehicles. 
Unit movement speed is now calculated based on maximum speed in an army. 
Units now turn towards the center of the battlefield at the start of combat.

[b]UI[/b]:
Added a scroll bar to the faction panel on the diplomacy screen.
Added an option to disable interface scaling in settings. In addition, owners of widescreen monitors should see the size of the game’s interface scale more correctly.

When attacking vassalized warriors in their homeland, your vassal will now be aware of such activities and their loyalty will be reduced.
Increased the amount of reputation and money received for plundering a tribe: from +5 and +5 to +50 and +50 respectively.
Fixed a bug with an incorrect amount of resources received when defeating a tribe.  

[b]Miscellaneous:
[/b]Fixed a bug with loading saves. Now save files take into account factions ‘known’ by the player.

tags.bug: City and combat panels now remain correctly positioned within set boundaries;

When you take over another city, the surrounding fence is automatically rebuilt, as it should be;
All the factors that influence tribe loyalty are now displayed correctly;
Fixed a bug with tribe assimilation, tribal warriors should now be available to the player;
Fixed a bug related to improving districts.

Destroying automatons does not negatively affect your relationships with tribes;
